Maya (PM): Heads-up: enterprise asks for stronger tenant isolation + clear pricing. Need prioritization proposal by Friday.
Leo (Arch): Recommend discrete tiers (bronze/silver/gold) covering network, compute pool, and KV cache. Will outline tradeoffs.
Sam (Eng): Bronze = shared pools with soft affinity; Silver = dedicated slices + soft-eviction; Gold = isolated pools, no auto-fallback.
Anne (SRE): Note failover semantics: Silver allows controlled spill under pressure; Gold requires manual failover and stricter runbooks.
Rick (Sales): Customers want predictable latency and data residency. Need placeholder pricing deltas for initial talks.
Maya (PM): Deliverables by EOW: tier spec, SLO matrix & rollback criteria, migration UX options (self-serve/SE-assisted/managed), pilot plan. Drop links here.
